Appendix C Omitted proofs from Section 4

We use the potential function, previously used by (Tran-Dinh and Luo, 2021),

𝒱k:=\displaystyle\mathcal{V}_{k}:= Ak​‖F⁡(𝐮k)‖2+Bk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),𝐮k−𝐮0⟩+ck​L2​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2,\displaystyle A_{k}\|F(\mathbf{u}_{k})\|^{2}+B_{k}\left\langle F(\mathbf{u}_{k}),\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{u}_{0}\right\rangle+c_{k}L^{2}\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\|^{2}, (C.1)

prove Theorem 4.1. Here AkA_{k}, BkB_{k} and ckc_{k} are positive parameters to be determined later. We start by bounding the change of 𝒱k\mathcal{V}_{k} under the following assumption on the parameters.

Assumption 5.

λk∈[0,1)\lambda_{k}\in\left[0,1\right), ηk>0\eta_{k}>0, and AkA_{k}, BkB_{k} and ckc_{k} are positive parameters satisfying Bk+1=Bk1−λkB_{k+1}=\frac{B_{k}}{1-\lambda_{k}}, Ak=Bk​ηk2​λkA_{k}=\frac{B_{k}\eta_{k}}{2\lambda_{k}},

0<ηk+1=(1−λk2−M​ηk2)​λk+1​ηk(1−M​ηk2)​(1−λk)​λk,Mηk2+λk2<1,and ηk+1≤λk+1​(1−λk)M​λk​ηk,0<\eta_{k+1}=\frac{\big(1-\lambda_{k}^{2}-M\eta_{k}^{2}\big)\lambda_{k+1}\eta_{k}}{\big(1-M\eta_{k}^{2}\big)\big(1-\lambda_{k}\big)\lambda_{k}},\quad M\eta_{k}^{2}+\lambda_{k}^{2}<1,\quad\text{and }\quad\eta_{k+1}\leq\frac{\lambda_{k+1}\big(1-\lambda_{k}\big)}{M\lambda_{k}\eta_{k}}, (C.2)

where M=3​L2​(2+θ)M=3L^{2}(2+\theta) and θ>0\theta>0 is some parameter that can be determined later.

The following lemma gives a bound on the difference between the potential function values at two consecutive iterations with the control of the parameters above.

Lemma C.1.

Let 𝒱k\mathcal{V}_{k} be defined as in Eq. (C.1), where the parameters satisfy Assumption 5. Then the difference of potential function between two consecutive iterations can be bounded by

𝒱k+1−𝒱k≤\displaystyle\mathcal{V}_{k+1}-\mathcal{V}_{k}\leq −L2​(θ​AkM​ηk2−ck+1)​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2−L2​(ck−Ak)​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle-L^{2}\bigg(\frac{\theta A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}-c_{k+1}\bigg)\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\|^{2}-L^{2}(c_{k}-A_{k})\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\|^{2} (C.3)
+2​AkM​ηk2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2+Ak​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2.\displaystyle+\frac{2A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\right\|^{2}+A_{k}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})\right\|^{2}.
Proof.

By the iteration scheme in Eq. (4.1), we can deduce the following identities:

{𝐮k+1−𝐮k=λk​(𝐮0−𝐮k)−ηk​F~​(𝐯k)𝐮k+1−𝐮k=λk1−λk​(𝐮0−𝐮k+1)−ηk1−λk​F~​(𝐯k)𝐮k+1−𝐯k=−ηk​(F~​(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k−1))\left\{\begin{aligned} \mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{u}_{k}&=\lambda_{k}(\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}_{k})-\eta_{k}\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\\ \mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{u}_{k}&=\frac{\lambda_{k}}{1-\lambda_{k}}(\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}_{k+1})-\frac{\eta_{k}}{1-\lambda_{k}}\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\\ \mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}&=-\eta_{k}\left(\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right)\end{aligned}\right. (C.4)

Further, by the definition of the potential function 𝒱k\mathcal{V}_{k}, we can write

𝒱k−𝒱k+1=\displaystyle\mathcal{V}_{k}-\mathcal{V}_{k+1}= Ak​‖F⁡(𝐮k)‖2−Ak+1​‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)‖2⏟𝒯[1]\displaystyle\underbrace{A_{k}\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}-A_{k+1}\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)\right\|^{2}}_{\mathcal{T}_{[1]}} (C.5)
+Bk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),𝐮k−𝐮0⟩−Bk+1​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),𝐮k+1−𝐮0⟩⏟𝒯[2]\displaystyle+\underbrace{B_{k}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{u}_{0}\right\rangle-B_{k+1}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{u}_{0}\right\rangle}_{\mathcal{T}_{[2]}}
+ck​L2​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2−ck+1​L2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2.\displaystyle+c_{k}L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}-c_{k+1}L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}.

To obtain the claimed bound, in the rest of the proof we focus on bounding 𝒯[1]\mathcal{T}_{[1]} and 𝒯[2].\mathcal{T}_{[2]}.

To bound 𝒯[1]\mathcal{T}_{[1]}, by the Lipschitz continuity of FF, we have

‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F⁡(𝐯k)‖2≤L2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2=L2​ηk2​‖F~​(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2,\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}\leq L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}=L^{2}\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2},

where in the last step we used the third identity from Eq. (C.4). Further, for any θ>0\theta>0

‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2+θ​L2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2\displaystyle\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}+\theta L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2} (C.6)
≤\displaystyle\leq 2​‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F⁡(𝐯k)‖2+2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2+θ​L2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2\displaystyle 2\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}+2\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}+\theta L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq ηk2​L2​(2+θ)​‖F~​(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2+2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2,\displaystyle\eta_{k}^{2}L^{2}(2+\theta)\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}+2\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2},

where again in the last step we used the third identity from Eq. (C.4). Notice that

‖F~​(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2\displaystyle\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}
=\displaystyle= ‖F~​(𝐯k)−F⁡(𝐮k)+F⁡(𝐮k)−F⁡(𝐯k−1)+F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2\displaystyle\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)+F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)+F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq 3​‖F~​(𝐯k)−F⁡(𝐮k)‖2+3​‖F⁡(𝐮k)−F⁡(𝐯k−1)‖2+3​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2\displaystyle 3\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}+3\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}+3\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq 3​(‖F⁡(𝐮k)‖2−2​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩+‖F~​(𝐯k)‖2)+3​L2​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle 3\Big(\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}-2\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle+\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}\Big)+3L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}
+3​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2.\displaystyle+3\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}.

Let M:=3​L2​(2+θ)M:=3L^{2}(2+\theta). Expanding the term ‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2\|{F(\mathbf{u}_{k+1})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})}\|^{2} on the LHS in Inequality (C.6) and combining with the inequality above, we have

‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)‖2+‖F~​(𝐯k)‖2−2​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),F~​(𝐯k)⟩+θ​L2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2\displaystyle\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)\right\|^{2}+\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}-2\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle+\theta L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}
≤\displaystyle\leq M​ηk2​(‖F⁡(𝐮k)‖2−2​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩+‖F~​(𝐯k)‖2)+M​L2​ηk2​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle M\eta_{k}^{2}\left(\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}-2\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle+\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}\right)+ML^{2}\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}
+M​ηk2​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2+2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2.\displaystyle+M\eta_{k}^{2}\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right)\right\|^{2}+2\left\|F\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)-\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}.

Multiplying both sides by AkM​ηk2\frac{A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}, rearranging this inequality and subtracting Ak+1​‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)‖2A_{k+1}\left\|F(\mathbf{u}_{k+1})\right\|^{2} on both sides, we obtain

𝒯[1]=\displaystyle\mathcal{T}_{[1]}= Ak​‖F⁡(𝐮k)‖2−Ak+1​‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)‖2\displaystyle A_{k}\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}-A_{k+1}\left\|F(\mathbf{u}_{k+1})\right\|^{2} (C.7)
≥\displaystyle\geq (AkM​ηk2−Ak+1)​‖F⁡(𝐮k+1)‖2+Ak​(1−M​ηk2)M​ηk2​‖F~​(𝐯k)‖2\displaystyle\left(\frac{A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}-A_{k+1}\right)\left\|F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)\right\|^{2}+\frac{A_{k}\left(1-M\eta_{k}^{2}\right)}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\|^{2}
−2​Ak​(1−M​ηk2)M​ηk2​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),F~​(𝐯k)⟩−2​Ak​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩\displaystyle-\frac{2A_{k}\left(1-M\eta_{k}^{2}\right)}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle-2A_{k}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle
+Ak​θ​L2M​ηk2​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2−Ak​L2​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle+\frac{A_{k}\theta L^{2}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}-A_{k}L^{2}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}
−2​AkM​ηk2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2−Ak​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2.\displaystyle-\frac{2A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\right\|^{2}-A_{k}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})\right\|^{2}.

To bound 𝒯[2]\mathcal{T}_{[2]}, notice that FF is monotone, so we have

⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),𝐮k+1−𝐮k⟩≥⟨F⁡(𝐮k),𝐮k+1−𝐮k⟩.\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{u}_{k}\right\rangle\geq\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{u}_{k}\right\rangle.

Using the first line in Eq. (C.4) for the RHS and the second line for the LHS, we can obtain

λk1−λk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),𝐮0−𝐮k+1⟩≥\displaystyle\frac{\lambda_{k}}{1-\lambda_{k}}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right\rangle\geq λk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),𝐮0−𝐮k⟩−ηk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩\displaystyle\lambda_{k}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}_{k}\right\rangle-\eta_{k}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle
+ηk1−λk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),F~​(𝐯k)⟩.\displaystyle+\frac{\eta_{k}}{1-\lambda_{k}}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle.

𝒯[2]≥\displaystyle\mathcal{T}_{[2]}\geq Bk​ηkλk​(1−λk)​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),F~​(𝐯k)⟩−Bk​ηkλk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩\displaystyle\frac{B_{k}\eta_{k}}{\lambda_{k}\left(1-\lambda_{k}\right)}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle-\frac{B_{k}\eta_{k}}{\lambda_{k}}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle (C.8)
=\displaystyle= Bk+1​ηk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1),F~​(𝐯k)⟩+Bk​ηkλk​⟨F⁡(𝐮k+1)−F⁡(𝐮k),F~​(𝐯k)⟩.\displaystyle B_{k+1}\eta_{k}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle+\frac{B_{k}\eta_{k}}{\lambda_{k}}\left\langle F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k+1}\right)-F\left(\mathbf{u}_{k}\right),\widetilde{F}\left(\mathbf{v}_{k}\right)\right\rangle.

+L2​(Ak​θM​ηk2−ck+1)​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2+L2​(ck−Ak)​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle+L^{2}\left(\frac{A_{k}\theta}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}-c_{k+1}\right)\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}+L^{2}\left(c_{k}-A_{k}\right)\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}

−2​AkM​ηk2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2−Ak​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2\displaystyle-\frac{2A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\right\|^{2}-A_{k}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})\right\|^{2}
≥\displaystyle\geq L2​(Ak​θM​ηk2−ck+1)​‖𝐮k+1−𝐯k‖2+L2​(ck−Ak)​‖𝐮k−𝐯k−1‖2\displaystyle L^{2}\left(\frac{A_{k}\theta}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}-c_{k+1}\right)\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k+1}-\mathbf{v}_{k}\right\|^{2}+L^{2}\left(c_{k}-A_{k}\right)\left\|\mathbf{u}_{k}-\mathbf{v}_{k-1}\right\|^{2}
−2​AkM​ηk2​‖F⁡(𝐯k)−F~​(𝐯k)‖2−Ak​‖F⁡(𝐯k−1)−F~​(𝐯k−1)‖2.\displaystyle-\frac{2A_{k}}{M\eta_{k}^{2}}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k})\right\|^{2}-A_{k}\left\|F(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})-\widetilde{F}(\mathbf{v}_{k-1})\right\|^{2}.

Lemma C.3.

Let 𝐮0∈ℝd\mathbf{u}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d} be an arbitrary initial point and assume that iterates 𝐮k\mathbf{u}_{k} evolve according to Algorithm 2. Then, Algorithm 2 returns a point 𝐮N\mathbf{u}_{N} such that 𝔼⁡[‖F⁡(𝐮N)‖2]≤2​Λ1​ϵ2\mathbb{E}\big[\left\|F(\mathbf{u}_{N})\right\|^{2}\big]\leq 2\Lambda_{1}\epsilon^{2} after at most 𝒪⁡(σ2​L​‖𝐮0−𝐮∗‖+L3​‖𝐮0−𝐮∗‖3ϵ3)\mathcal{O}\big(\frac{\sigma^{2}L\left\|\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}^{*}\right\|+L^{3}\left\|\mathbf{u}_{0}-\mathbf{u}^{*}\right\|^{3}}{\epsilon^{3}}\big) stochastic queries to FF.

Proof.

Let mkm_{k} be the number of stochastic queries made by the variance reduction method at iteration kk for k≥1k\geq 1. Conditional on ℱk−1\mathcal{F}_{k-1}, we have
